answer: PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) is the quality gate automotive OEMs and other manufacturers require suppliers to pass before delivering series production parts: the supplier submits samples and objective evidence (dimensional results, material and performance test data, process capability studies, and the process control plan) so the customer can confirm parts made at quoted production rates consistently meet drawings and specifications. It is a documentation-and-evidence package, normally with five levels of submission, and it is not a certification itself.
